content.summary: Kitchen product manufacturer Middleby (NYSE:MIDD) reported Q2 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 1.4% year on year to $977.9 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $962.5 million was less impressive, coming in 0.8% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.35 per share was 5.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
